NEW_RSM_Properties.description: New ResMan properties that need added to SharePoint

UPD_RSM_Properties.description: Updated ResMan properties that need updated in SharePoint too

CMN_Properties.description: Properties common in ResMan and SharePoint

DEL_SPL_Properties.description: Existing SharePoint properties that need to be deleted since they don't exist in ResMan

inputs.uri: @{parameters('UPM-DHA ResMan API (Base URL) (clr_UPMDHAResManAPIBaseURL)')}/Leasing/Leases?propertyId=@{items('Each_SPL_Proprty')?['propertyId']}&modifiedSince=@{parameters('UPM-DHA ResMan API (Filter | Modified Since) (clr_UPMDHAResManAPIFilterModifiedSince)')}&includeLeaseHistory=false

inputs.select:
@addProperty(
    json(xml(item()))?['people'],
    'lease',
    removeProperty(
        json(
            xml(
                first(
                    xpath(
                        outputs('RSM_Leases_XML'),
                        concat(
                            '//leases[',
                                'people[',
                                    'personId="', json(xml(item()))?['people']?['personId'], '"',
                                    ' and residencyStatus="', json(xml(item()))?['people']?['residencyStatus'], '"',
                                    ' and lastModified="', json(xml(item()))?['people']?['lastModified'], '"',
                                    ' and string(moveInDate)="', coalesce(json(xml(item()))?['people']?['moveInDate'], ''), '"',
                                    ' and string(moveOutDate)="', coalesce(json(xml(item()))?['people']?['moveOutDate'], ''), '"',
                                ']',
                            ']'
                        )
                    )
                )
            )
        )?['leases'],
        'people'
    )
)
